description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git operations, including adding, modifying, and committing files, and testing the behavior of 'git add -u' and 'git commit -a'. It uses external test libraries and sets up a series of repository states to validate Git's handling of file changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites needed before running certain tests.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or state.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output for test validation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
